subject: S5 to S6 level 3 to 4 transition hidden by the original footage cut
confidence: High that a level-up occurred inside the cut; low for amount, source and trigger
observations: Original final-week video 8VXeKzGUv0c remains level 3 through B2-002 and the final boot-camp frame 98.333 s. The XP bar does not move through the 86.6 s detonation to 98.333 s.
The hard edit 98.333 to 98.400 s omits the Van Valkenberg check-in, exit pad/transport, any intervening kills, and any full XP message.

At the first Alia Das frame B2-016 the player is level 4. The chat already contains the tail of the level-up line, 'points and 2 skill points.' (B2-017), so the level-up predates that frame. Mission 1995 is displayed as '(complete)' (B2-022), which does not establish that a reward was collected.

The level-3 XP bar in sheet_xpbar_79_99.png is roughly one quarter filled. The emulator threshold table has 10500 cumulative XP for level 3 and 24000 for level 4. With that table, the missing gain is on the order of 10000-11000 XP, but image resolution, unknown preceding XP and unseen kills prevent an exact bound.

Known seeded fixed gains before 1995 are 1250 (1990), 1250 (1992), 500 (1994 promotion), and 5000 (1994 reward): 8000 total. The original reaches level 3 through observed/unseen combat before the blast; a no-kill emulator route cannot use those combat gains as a fixed S5 grant.
source_audit: The previous focused reward search found no final-live 1995 or 2005 payout in original client tables, surviving footage, TaRapedia/Ellatha mission listings, contemporary notes, or targeted web search. A fresh 2026-09-24 web search for the exact mission title with Van Valkenberg, Youngblood and XP likewise returned no relevant contemporary result.
decision: Do not seed a fixed or dynamic XP grant yet. A candidate 10000-11000 grant is only an inferred interval needed to match this edited playthrough, not evidence of a retail mission reward. Its exact value and triggering event (Van Valkenberg objective, exit transfer, unseen kills, or another event) are unknown. A dynamic top-up to level 4 would add a custom catch-up mechanic. Keep GAP-S5-HIDDEN-XP and GAP-S5-MISSION-REWARDS open, and continue implementing independent S6 systems. Revisit when a readable uncut final-live transition or packet capture identifies at least the source and trigger; if a provisional grant becomes necessary for a concrete blocked progression gate, label each field as inferred or analogue and verify its effects on the level curve.
